##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 15 August 2026 at 11:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over the Azores extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 or 4, becoming variable 2 to 4 overnight, settling west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then a few outbreaks of rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southwest 3 or 4 Sunday evening, veering west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Often fair, but with occasional patchy light rain.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain.
